assets.name: St. George Antiochian Orthodox Church
assets.summary: A source-owner UAV photogrammetry mesh with captured vertex colour. The direct conversion retains every source triangle, including faces an earlier Blender import omitted.
assets.attribution: Rucha Shende, Sudhir Mudur, Tiberiu Popa and Kaustubha Mendhurwar, Heritage3DMtl, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17063337, CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Exterior capture; complete interiors and concealed surfaces are not supplied.
Physical scale, georeference and independent survey error are unverified.
Captured vertex colour is not calibrated albedo or a complete PBR material.
The source MTL is absent; no image texture maps were invented.
assets.previewNote: Blender render of the inspected source exterior; the preview import omits 11 faces.
changes: Direct OBJ to Float32 GLB conversion; source normals, RGB, triangle indices and coordinates retained.
Losslessly checked meshopt encoding; no decimation, scaling or generated detail.

assets.name: Kailasa Temple — exterior context
assets.summary: Actual-site exterior context showing the temple, courtyard and cut rock. This source is too coarse to support the requested carving-by-carving fidelity.
assets.attribution: GSXNet / gsxn (embedded credit); Graphic solutions (current listing), Ellora Caves, through Objaverse / Zenodo 10269303, CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Fine relief and complete interiors are not captured at the requested detail.
Scale, survey control, capture provenance and epoch remain unverified.
Separate Cave 16 carving references are not registered to this mesh.
assets.previewNote: Blender preview contains 136,498 triangles: the importer omitted 1 of the 136,499 triangles retained in the downloadable preserving GLB. Cause unverified; coarse relief is not enhanced.
changes: Full supplied GLB geometry, image bytes and node transforms retained.
Compression decoded and compared against the supplied source document; no detail invented.

references.label: CC BY-NC 4.0 / source only
references.name: Four Cave 16 carving captures
references.description: Arno Klein’s source-owner photogrammetry includes four explicitly named c16_ relief files, with 52,735–92,218 triangles per fragment and three 4096px images per file.
references.limitation: Separate cropped fragments; scale and whole-temple registration unverified. Acquired for research; excluded from the public game-asset payload.

references.label: View only / download disabled
references.name: Sidhu’s Kailasa photogrammetry
references.description: The original public listing reports approximately 2.94 million faces, providing a denser view of the temple than the bundled context source.
references.limitation: The inspected API disables downloads and supplies no reuse license. A larger face count does not establish measured accuracy.

references.label: Viewing / evaluation only
references.name: iTek’s Kailasa splat capture
references.description: The creator reports 49 million splats and a 1.5 GB optimized scene. These are creator-reported figures; no local accuracy or performance validation was performed.
references.limitation: The sample policy requires separate permission for reuse. A splat scene is not automatically an editable mesh, collision surface or complete interior.
